# Pinned coefficient fixture

These four `prototype_mtc` configuration files come from the installed
ActivitySim 1.5.1 package. Their hashes match the complete stock inventory under
`docs/modeling/activitysim-coefficients-2026-10-23/stock-files.json`.
They allow the transfer and default-preservation tests to run without installing
the model engine. They contain coefficients and specifications, not household
or person microdata. The upstream BSD license is retained in this directory.
